description: Cleanup class: hedging, politeness padding and filler that carries no information. Fires at lite intensity. Every rule here must be one a reviewer can agree cannot change meaning — if a rule could drop a fact, a number or a name, it does not belong in this pack.

rules.name: drop_i_wonder_if
rules.description: "I was wondering if X" → "X". The hedge adds no content.

rules.name: drop_please_note_that
rules.description: "please note that X" → "X". The framing is pure padding.

rules.name: drop_it_is_important_to_note
rules.description: Six words of throat-clearing before the actual point.

rules.name: drop_at_the_end_of_the_day
rules.description: Idiomatic filler with no semantic payload.

rules.name: drop_in_order_to
rules.description: "in order to run" → "to run". Identical meaning.

rules.name: drop_due_to_the_fact_that
rules.description: Seven words for one. Meaning preserved exactly.

rules.name: drop_i_think_that
rules.description: "I think that X is wrong" → "X is wrong". The assertion survives; only the hedge goes.

rules.name: drop_very_really_quite
rules.description: Intensifiers. Removing them cannot change a factual claim.

rules.name: collapse_whitespace_runs
rules.description: Runs of 3+ spaces collapse to one. Prose formatting, not content.
